title: VinFast VF MPV 7 (seven-seat electric MPV, India) costs ₹20.39 lakh ex-showroom, ₹4.1 lakh below its ₹24.49 lakh launch price (launched 15 Apr 2026); price cut reported 4 Nov 2026 (Autocar India 4 Nov, Business Today 5 Nov), no end date announced; still listed at ₹20.39 lakh on CarWale, CarDekho and ZigWheels model pages read 12 Nov 2026; one fully loaded variant; 60.13 kWh, 517 km claimed (ARAI), 10-70% DC in 30 min, 150 kW / 280 Nm FWD, seven seats, up to 1,240 litres (VinFast India release 15 Apr 2026)
